description: This header file defines the structure and interface functions for a DRM-based screen capture module, including initialization, screen info retrieval, screen capture, and destruction routines.

methods.name: DRMScreenCapture_Init
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new DRMScreenCapture handle.

methods.name: DRMScreenCapture_GetScreenInfo
methods.description: Fills in screen information into the handle.

methods.name: DRMScreenCapture_ScreenCapture
methods.description: Performs a screen capture and stores the output data.

methods.name: DRMScreenCapture_Destroy
methods.description: Destroys and cleans up the screen capture handle.
